description: Views and feature tests: create all 10 Blade views (5 non-print + 4 print + performance trends) and FinancialReportUiTest. Depends on FEAT-001 (routes, controller, translations, and view composer must exist first).
steps: Create resources/views/reports/index.blade.php. Extends layouts.inventory, @section('page-content'). Two-line header: teal label __('ui.navigation.reports'), h1 __('ui.reports.title'). Secondary nav row with links to all five reports using button-primary/button-secondary active state via request()->routeIs(). Card grid: five <a href> cards with rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 hover:border-teal-300 hover:shadow-sm, each showing report name (bold) and one-line description from ui.reports.*_description keys.

Create resources/views/reports/trial-balance.blade.php. Extends layouts.inventory. Filter form (GET, action='', grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4): date_from, date_to, Apply and Clear buttons. Values pre-populated from $filters. Incomplete-data warning banner: @if($report['status'] !== 'complete') amber div with __('ui.reports.incomplete_data_warning'). Table with 8 columns (code, name, opening debit, opening credit, period debit, period credit, closing debit, closing credit). All six amount columns: number_format((float)$value,4).' '.$report['currency'] wrapped in <bdi dir='ltr'>. Totals footer from $report['totals']. If $report['native_currency_totals'] is non-empty, render collapsible section with the native-currency summary.

Create resources/views/reports/trial-balance-print.blade.php. Extends layouts.app, @section('content'). <main class='mx-auto max-w-5xl p-4 sm:p-8'>. Print controls div: Back <a href='{{ route('reports.trial-balance', request()->query()) }}' class='button button-secondary'> and <button type='button' class='button button-primary' data-print-document>. Article with document header (company name from $activeCompany->name, app name, report title, period). Same table as non-print view, no filter form.

Create resources/views/reports/general-ledger.blade.php. Extends layouts.inventory. Filter form with date_from, date_to, plus account <select> populated from $accounts (first option: 'All accounts' empty value, then each account as 'code – name', pre-selected when $filters['account_id'] matches). Incomplete-data banner. Table 10 columns: date, journal #, description, source ref, debit (native), credit (native), currency, base debit, base credit, running balance. When $transaction['debit'] is null, debit and credit native cells render '—'. Running balance from $transaction['running_balance_base']. Empty state: __('ui.reports.no_transactions') when $report['transactions'] is empty.
Create resources/views/reports/general-ledger-print.blade.php. Same print structure as trial-balance-print. Back link: route('reports.general-ledger', request()->query()).

Create resources/views/reports/income-statement.blade.php. Extends layouts.inventory. Filter form with date_from, date_to, comparison_from, comparison_to (all four date fields). Incomplete-data banner. <dl> layout. Eight metric rows using these exact service keys and translation keys: revenue/metric_revenue, cost_of_goods_sold/metric_cogs, gross_profit/metric_gross_profit, gross_margin_percentage/metric_gross_margin (append '%' no currency), operating_expenses/metric_operating_expenses, other_income/metric_other_income, other_expenses/metric_other_expenses, net_profit/metric_net_profit. Each row shows: metric name, current-period value (or metric_unavailable badge when $metric['availability'] !== 'available'), and when comparison dates were submitted, the comparison value, difference, and percentage change. CRITICAL (residual finding #2): wrap the comparison columns for gross_margin_percentage in @isset($metric['comparison']) ... @endisset because the service's comparison loop omits this metric. Apply the same @isset guard to all eight metrics for safety.
Create resources/views/reports/income-statement-print.blade.php. Same print structure. Back link: route('reports.income-statement', request()->query()).

Create resources/views/reports/balance-sheet.blade.php. Extends layouts.inventory. Filter form with as_of_date and optional period_start. Balance status badge in page header using $report['status'] ('balanced' green, 'discrepant'/'incomplete' amber). Incomplete banner when $report['status'] !== 'balanced'. Three <section class='panel'>: Assets (account list table + total_assets row), Liabilities (account list table + total_liabilities row), Equity (account list table + three extra rows for account_balances_total, current_period_earnings, prior_unclosed_earnings + total_equity row). Footer row: total_liabilities_and_equity from $report['equation']['total_liabilities_and_equity'].
Create resources/views/reports/balance-sheet-print.blade.php. Same print structure. Back link: route('reports.balance-sheet', request()->query()).

Create resources/views/reports/performance-trends.blade.php. Extends layouts.inventory. Filter form with date_from, date_to. Incomplete-data banner. Single wide table with overflow-x-auto wrapper. Month column headers from array_keys($report['months']) formatted as-is (Y-m strings from service). Seven data rows with these EXACT singular/plural key distinctions from $months[$monthKey]: revenue, cost_of_goods_sold, gross_profit, operating_expense (SINGULAR), other_income, other_expense (SINGULAR), net_profit.

Create tests/Feature/FinancialReportUiTest.php. Uses RefreshDatabase. Local financialReportUiSetUp() helper (following accountingUiSetUp() pattern in AccountingUiTest.php): creates company, user, attaches user to company, calls app(CompanyContextService::class)->switchTo($user, $company->getKey()), creates one FinancialAccount per type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense). Posts at least one journal using AccountingService helpers. Sixteen Pest it() tests: AC-1 (GET /reports 200 with five report names), AC-2 (trial-balance 200 with table headings), AC-3 (trial-balance missing date_from redirects with errors), AC-4 (general-ledger 200), AC-5 (general-ledger with foreign account_id returns validation error), AC-6 (income-statement 200 shows all eight metric label translations), AC-7 (income-statement with both comparison dates shows comparison column heading), AC-8 (income-statement with only comparison_from redirects with error on comparison_to field), AC-9 (balance-sheet 200 shows assets/liabilities/equity headings), AC-10 (performance-trends 200 renders monthly table), AC-11 (trial-balance/print 200 contains data-print-document), AC-13 (unauthenticated GET /reports redirects to /login), AC-14 (user with two companies and no session context gets 409 on GET /reports), AC-15 (English page has no raw ui.reports. literals), AC-16 (Arabic locale: assertSee('<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">', false) and assertSee('<bdi dir="ltr">', false)), AC-17 (all tests in this file pass — implicitly verified by running the suite).
acceptance_criteria: php artisan test --filter FinancialReportUiTest passes all 16 tests with no errors
php artisan test --filter NavigationTest still passes (AC-18 regression check)
php artisan test passes the full suite with no new failures
No 'Undefined variable $activeCompany' or 'Undefined index: comparison' errors
income-statement view renders without throwing when comparison period is not supplied (gross_margin_percentage @isset guard works)
findings: All 15 FinancialReportUiTest tests pass. NavigationTest passes (4 tests). Full suite passes (544 tests, 2319 assertions). Key fixes applied during implementation: (1) Added missing 'incomplete_data_warning' and 'metric_unavailable' keys to both lang/en/ui.php and lang/ar/ui.php. (2) Balance sheet view uses $report['total_liabilities_and_equity'] (top-level key) not $report['equation']['total_liabilities_and_equity'] — the service returns this as a top-level key. (3) Performance trends view uses singular keys 'operating_expense' and 'other_expense' (matching the service's emptyStatementAmounts() output) not the plural variants from the step description. (4) AC-5 test creates the foreign FinancialAccount inside runForCompany($otherCompany) to avoid TenantScoped cross-company validation on the creating event. Verification: php artisan test --filter FinancialReportUiTest → 15 passed; php artisan test --filter NavigationTest → 4 passed; php artisan test → 544 passed, 0 failed.
